title: Exterior power shifted by a locally constant rank function
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $M$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $r:X\to\mathbf N$ a locally constant function. For $n\geq0$, put $X_n=\{x:r(x)=n\}$, an open and closed subscheme, and let $j_n:X_n\to X$ be its inclusion. Define the cochain complex [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] $L(M,r)$ by $L^n=j_{n*}(\bigwedge^n(M|_{X_n}))$ for $n\geq0$, $L^n=0$ for $n<0$, with all differentials zero. Here the exterior sheaf is that of [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], restriction is the usual restriction of module sheaves to an open subscheme, and $j_{n*}F$ has sections $F(V\cap X_n)$ on each open $V$ of $X$, with scalars restricted from $\mathcal O_X(V)$. Since $X_n$ is clopen, this direct image is extension by zero. Thus on $X_n$ the complex is $\bigwedge^n(M|_{X_n})[-n]$; it represents the expression $\bigwedge^r M[-r]$ with varying locally constant $r$.
